items.title: Align decision-doc audits with automatic escalation policy
items.context: Replace the always-on decision-doc 3x2 rule in the execution plan with a unified audit policy: documentation/decision-doc changes start with ordinary REVIEW, escalate to full 3x2 only when first REVIEW round has at least two countable problems, and can use explicit degraded 3x1 under the same fallback rules.
items.userSees: User sees: The plan now says documentation and decision-doc audit follow normal REVIEW first, then automatic full 3x2 or degraded 3x1 only when the same escalation rules trigger.

happy.desc: The document says documentation and decision-doc audit use the same ordinary REVIEW default as other development work.
The document says documentation and decision-doc audit escalate to 3x2 only when the first REVIEW round records at least two countable problems.

edge.desc: The document states current code may still enforce legacy decision-doc 3x2 until the implementation story updates the gate.
The document says documentation audit can use the same explicit degraded 3x1 fallback when allowed by policy or approval.

adversarial.desc: The document no longer preserves always-on decision-doc 3x2 as the desired target policy.
The document does not claim the automatic document-audit policy is already implemented in runtime code.
